timezone.meaning: Installed slash-separated IANA timezone below the zoneinfo root. HomeServer keeps UTC.

primitive.meaning: set-timezone for a timezone outcome; invalid when intake, policy, state or invocation raised.

changed.meaning: True when timedatectl and readback confirm a newly applied zone. A pending change can be recorded while this is false.

previously_applied_timezone.meaning: Previously recorded applied zone, or null on the first application.

applied_timezone.meaning: Confirmed applied zone on success, or prior recorded zone on a hold or failed apply.

debounce_gated.meaning: True when a different zone is held pending instead of immediately applied.

hold_seconds.meaning: Effective debounce interval in a held response; chosen from CADUCEUS_TIMEZONE_HOLD_SECONDS, not the payload.

post_apply.meaning: timedatectl show/status results and parsed properties.

values.meaning: Properties parsed from show and filled from status when absent; may include NTPSynchronized, NTP and Timezone.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Literal outcomes emitted by the stop and its envelope reader. The envelope reader can also emit missing envelope kernel keys: followed by the comma-joined missing keys. Unnormalized exception text can also be returned; those values are not a finite enum.
